annotations.title: Size the first version (MVP) of a software product

description: Suggests the scope of the first version of a planned software product from up to 7 answers: what is being built (web app or SaaS, marketplace, app for the Apple and Google stores, internal business system), the stage, number of user types, an AI feature, payments, integrations and the deadline. Returns the starting tier that fits (clickable prototype, MVP live, MVP with AI and Israeli payments, or a scope that needs a written quote), its timeline, why, and what goes into the first version versus what waits for the next one, in Hebrew. Use when a founder asks what an MVP for their idea should include, how long a first version takes, or what to leave for later. Answers may be given as the ids below or in Hebrew.

ai.description: An AI feature inside the product (chat, document analysis, text or image generation), optional. no = לא; yes = כן, פיצ'ר AI בעברית

integrations.description: Existing systems to connect, any number, optional. whatsapp = וואטסאפ; crm = CRM; invoices = מערכת חשבוניות; calendar = יומן; other = מערכת אחרת שכבר יש לכם

pay.description: Payments in the first version, optional. none = בלי תשלום בגרסה הראשונה; card = תשלום בכרטיס (Stripe); il = סליקה ישראלית

roles.description: How many types of users (e.g. customer and admin = 2), optional. 1 = סוג אחד; 2 = שניים; 3 = 3 ומעלה

stage.description: Where the founder is today, optional. idea = יש רעיון, עוד לא דיברנו עם לקוחות; talked = דיברנו עם לקוחות, צריך משהו להראות; demand = יש לקוחות שמחכים או מוכנים לשלם

type.description: What is being built. web = אפליקציית ווב או SaaS; market = מרקטפלייס: קונים ומוכרים; store = אפליקציה לחנויות (אפל וגוגל); internal = מערכת פנימית לעסק; unsure = עוד לא בטוחים

when.description: When it must be live, optional. 2w = תוך שבועיים; 1m = תוך חודש; 2m = תוך חודשיים; flex = אין תאריך קבוע

name: mvp_scope_sizer
title: Size the first version (MVP) of a software product
